findings.problem: English context note: the note says 'Rendered inside the sentence ui.library.preview.unsupported ONLY via the generic fallback; see manifest.' The label is never substituted into that sentence - library-viewers.tsx:108 renders ui.library.preview.unsupported_generic for kind === 'other', and that message has no {kind} slot.
